source_caption:
David Lynch appears near the end of The Fabelmans as legendary director John Ford, and his scene is only a few minutes long—but it completely steals the film. Ford’s blunt advice about where to place the horizon is based on a real meeting Steven Spielberg had with him as a teenager, turning the final shot into both a filmmaking lesson and a perfect tribute to cinema itself.

The Fabelmans (2022), directed by Steven Spielberg, starring Gabriel LaBelle, Michelle Williams, Paul Dano. A deeply personal coming-of-age drama inspired by Spielberg’s own childhood, exploring family, art, and the moment a young filmmaker begins to understand the power of images.

source_details.title: The Fabelmans
source_details.synopsis: The Fabelmans is a 2022 American coming-of-age drama film directed and produced by Steven Spielberg, who co-wrote the screenplay with Tony Kushner. Loosely based on Spielberg's early life and beginnings as a filmmaker, the semi-autobiographical film follows Sammy Fabelman, a young aspiring filmmaker who explores how the power of films can help him see the truth about his dysfunctional family and those around him. It stars Gabriel LaBelle as Sammy, alongside Michelle Williams, Paul Dano, Seth Rogen, Judd Hirsch, and David Lynch (in his final acting role before his death in 2025) in supporting roles.
